definitions.short: Bilam , a Mesopotamian prophet; also a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H1109. Bil 'am I. בִּלְעָם proper name, masculine Balaam (according to Sta § 293 = בלע + ם ; Nbr Stud. Bib. i, 226 proposes בל = בעל + (god) עם ), son of בְּעוֺר , prophet from מְּתוֺר (q. v.): — Num 22:5 , 7 , 8 , 9 47t. Numbers 22-24 (all J E) 31:8 , 16 (P) Deut 23:5 ; 23:6 (D) (compare R D Josh 13:22 ) 24:9-10 , (E) Micah 6:5 ; Neh 13:2 . II. בִּלְעָם proper name, of a location town in Manasseh 1Chr 6:55 ; A Ιβλααμ , ᵐ5 L Ιεβλααμ = יִבְלְעָם (q. v.) Josh 17:11 2 t.; modern Bel`ame , 6 hours north of Nâblus, Bd Pal 228 , so Survey ii. 47 .
